title: 光子晶片光開關矩陣
summary: 從開關拓撲、損失串接與可觀測性拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate switch topology, cascaded loss and observability, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設一路經 6 個開關各 0.4 dB、4 個交叉各 0.05 dB、波導共 0.6 dB，總損失=3.2 dB；1 mW 輸入輸出約 0.479 mW。
workedExample.textEn: Assume six switches at 0.4 dB each, four crossings at 0.05 dB each and 0.6 dB routing loss. Total loss is 3.2 dB; 1 mW input gives about 0.479 mW.
workedExample.assumptions: 假設被動損失、無相干反射與增益；數字是教學工作負載。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Assume passive loss without coherent reflections or gain; values describe a teaching workload.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.
